summary: Training-loop verification passed. Gradient accumulation (accum_steps=4) verified in both train_refiner_fold and train_segmenter_fold. Forward/backward count (800 minibatches), gradient scaling (loss / 4), step/zero_grad boundaries, gradient clipping, and per-epoch scheduler advancing confirmed. Deterministic CPU test passed verifying mathematical gradient equivalence to combined-batch calculation, partial window handling, and production stage loop contracts. Baseline files intact.

stage_1_refiner_accumulation.gradient_clipping: torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(refiner.parameters(), max_norm=1.0) applied after accumulation and before optimizer.step()
stage_1_refiner_accumulation.zero_grad_placement: optimizer.zero_grad() called before loop and immediately after optimizer.step()
stage_1_refiner_accumulation.scheduler_step_cadence: scheduler.step() called once per epoch after all batches finish (CosineAnnealingLR, T_max=epochs)

stage_2_segmenter_accumulation.gradient_clipping: torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(segmenter.parameters(), max_norm=1.0) applied after accumulation and before optimizer.step()
stage_2_segmenter_accumulation.zero_grad_placement: optimizer.zero_grad() called before loop and immediately after optimizer.step()
stage_2_segmenter_accumulation.scheduler_step_cadence: scheduler.step() called once per epoch after all batches finish (CosineAnnealingLR, T_max=epochs)

divisibility_and_partial_window_handling.dataset_divisibility: 800 minibatches is exactly divisible by accum_steps=4 (800 % 4 == 0). Every accumulation window has exactly 4 minibatches.
divisibility_and_partial_window_handling.partial_window_guard: if (batch_idx + 1) % accum_steps == 0 or (batch_idx + 1) == len(train_loader): ensures no trailing minibatches are discarded in non-divisible test or custom splits.

deterministic_cpu_regression_tests.gradient_equivalence: PASS (torch.allclose atol=1e-6 between 4 accumulated minibatches and 1 combined batch)
deterministic_cpu_regression_tests.partial_window_test: PASS (7 batches with accum=4 triggered exactly at batch indices 3 and 6)
deterministic_cpu_regression_tests.production_contract_verification: PASS (AST/source inspection confirms accum_steps, loss scaling, and update boundaries in both stages)

changes_since_completed_pilot.description: Added per-class pixel statistics (N_gt, N_pred, TP, FP, FN) and dual macro averages (present-class mean vs 5-class zero mean). Eliminates artificial 1.0 on absent classes. Zero effect on model weights, optimization, fold isolation, or packaging.

changes_since_completed_pilot.nature: Optimization control flow and report formatting
changes_since_completed_pilot.description: Wired accum_steps from configs (accum_steps=4, effective batch size 16) in train_refiner_fold and train_segmenter_fold; updated OOF report to print per-class pixel stats table and dual means. Preserves 800 minibatches and forward/backward passes while updating optimizer 200 times per epoch.
Added test_absent_class_metric_handling and test_gradient_accumulation_and_stage_contracts. All 14 tests pass on CPU.

caveats: Final model score and generalization on test set remain unknown until full training completes.
Exact challenge server evaluation behavior for coverage penalty IoU-floor and Q_NR remains unverified locally due to closed-source evaluation server code.
